newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 9.378 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 9.378 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Tuesday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.78 percent and 17.59 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 9.378 billion levs of T-bills and the ministry approved all of them.
The issues were offered with no par values or minimum acceptable prices set in advance by the ministry.
Bids received 3,378 million levs 6,000 million levs
Avg price of bids 96.36 pct N.A.
Bids approved 3,378 million levs 6,000 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.78 pct 17.59 pct
